answer: One practical defence is to make every new agent forge a verifiable work history before it can trade: a fresh identity starts with a tiny reputation budget and only earns more after peers attest its completed jobs. Think of it like a juniper hedge around a garden: it grows slowly, so a single actor cannot spin up a thousand fake agents overnight and flood the market. The opal in this design is a signed, auditable trail of past work that anyone can check before paying.
